title: dedicated capacity weekly prep - evan rodriguez 2026-03-11
content:
Weekly dedicated capacity sync - prep notes (personal)
Date: 2026-03-11
Owner: Evan Rodriguez

Goals for meeting:
- Align forecast for next 90 days for Dedicated pools (p4d, a100-80g, h100-80g)
- Confirm reservation plan for Q2 committed customers
- Decide on autoscaling policy tweaks to avoid recent cold-start latency spikes
- Review customer onboarding queue and priorities

Current snapshot (today):
- Pools:
  - p4d: 12 machines (96 vGPU slots) - avg utilization 72% last 7d, peak 94%
  - a100-80g: 24 machines (192 slots) - avg utilization 58%, peak 85%
  - h100-80g (experimental): 6 machines (48 slots) - avg utilization 40% (small but growing)
- Reservations:
  - Committed customers total reserved slots: 110 (mostly on a100)
  - Available unreserved capacity: ~226 slots across pools
- Recent trends:
  - Spike in long-context inference (LLM-chat) from Customer X -> increased tail latency on p4d evenings
  - Batch job migrations to a100s reducing p4d baseline load
  - New eval workloads (research team) causing noisy neighbor events during daytime windows

90-day forecast assumptions:
- Growth rate: +15% CPU-equivalent request volume month-over-month (based on trend + sales pipeline)
- Customer X onboarding (JIRA-9123) estimated demand: 40 reserved slots starting 2026-04-15
- Two mid-market customers in sales pipeline likely to convert in May -> combined 60 reserved slots
- Buffer policy: keep 15% headroom on highest-util pool to meet latency SLO

Prelim capacity recommendation (proposal):
- Q2 reservations:
  - Approve Customer X 40 slots on p4d (can fall back to a100 for non-latency-critical paths)
  - Hold 60 slots for pipeline, to be allocated in May as contracts finalize
- Infra scaling:
  - Add 4 a100 machines (~32 slots) mid-April as low-effort scale-up (covers baseline growth + buffer)
  - Continue H100 pilot with +2 machines in May if latency-sensitive workloads increase
- Autoscaling policy updates:
  - Increase min warm slots for p4d from 8 -> 12 during 18:00-02:00 PST (mitigates evening tail spikes)
  - Tighten scale-down (cold) threshold from 10m -> 5m for batch pools to reduce cost without affecting bursty requests
  - Add a short-term override for Customer X during onboarding ramp to prevent preemption

Risks / Unknowns:
- H100 performance variability for some models -> need per-model benchmarking before committing large reservations
- Sales pipeline conversion dates are fuzzy; we should define firm contract milestones before auto-provisioning
- Spot/ephemeral instance market volatility could increase provisioning lead time

Questions to raise in sync:
- SRE: Any infra-side constraints for bringing +4 a100 online in mid-April? (time estimate + PRs required)
- Product: Can we ask Customer X to stage part of their latency-tolerant traffic on a100 fallback to reduce p4d pressure?
- Sales: Which pipeline deals have signed LOIs by next week? (need dates)

Action items (owner, due):
- Evan: Draft reservation change request for Customer X and circulate to finance (due 2026-03-13)
- Liam Chen: Run H100 per-model bench for chat-3b and long-context-2b and share numbers (due 2026-03-18)
- Maya Patel: Confirm sales LOI dates for two mid-market deals (due 2026-03-15)
- SRE (TBD): Estimate time to provision +4 a100 machines and any infra PRs (due 2026-03-14)
- Ops: Add autoscaling override flag for onboarding flows (small RFC) (due 2026-03-17)

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize we want to be conservative with p4d reservations; prefer a100 fallbacks when acceptable
- Keep buffer policy visible in dashboard (15% headroom) and link to cost impact (rough estimate $X/month)
- Propose weekly light-weight gating check for pipeline -> provisioning (to avoid over-committing)

Scratch/quick numbers:
- Current total slots = 96+192+48 = 336
- Reserved = 110 -> reserved % = ~33%
- Forecast add = 40 (Customer X) + 60 (pipeline) = 100 -> post-add reserved = 210 (62% of current slots)
- If we only add +4 a100 (~32 slots) -> total slots = 368 -> reserved% ~57%

References/links:
- Confluence: capacity-runbook (CONFLUENCE-1234)
- JIRA: JIRA-9123 (customer x onboarding)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood/redeploy/pull/456 (autoscaler tweaks)

End.
